title: Moroccan Shrimp Cakes
description: Delicious shrimp cakes flavored with Moroccan spices and a crunchy topping. Serve as an appetizer or snack.
instructions: In a food processor, chop the shrimp until they're coarsely ground.
In a large bowl, combine the shrimp, nutty, crumbly, moroccan, and crumble.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 patties.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with a little olive oil and gently press down on each patty.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the cakes are golden brown and cooked through.
Serve hot with a side of your favorite dipping sauce.
